project.name: Galactic Strike: Distributed Arcade Arena
project.sub: Sole developer of the course booth demo

slide.alt: Galactic Strike running at the exhibition booth

project.name: Hypro: Vanilla Web-Based Mobile IDE
project.sub: Sole developer

slide.alt: Hypro code editor on a phone

project.name: World Navigation Hat: Wearable AIoT Aid
project.sub: Leader, developer and researcher

slide.alt: Demo video of the World Navigation Hat in use
slide.stack: python, kotlin, nodejs, mediapipe, rpi, aiot, stereo, sensory
slide.info: Edge-fog-cloud AIoT smart hat for the visually impaired: stereo-vision depth maps become spatial audio pings (Edge), gestures replace visual controls (AI) and a phone bridges GPS telemetry to caregivers (Cloud). Runs on a Raspberry Pi 4 across Python, Kotlin and Node.js; I led the thesis and wrote the code. Source code is confidential.

project.name: Lasortech RMA System

Demo login: demo@example.com / admin123.
